title: BenchmarkRepository
responsibility: Atomically persists private benchmark run records and marks abandoned live trials as interrupted.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Directory containing the private persisted benchmark run subfolders.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.save.run
inputs.description: Pinned benchmark definition, candidate configurations and recorded trial outcomes.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.directory
outputs.description: Private subdirectory for the validated run identifier.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.save
outputs.description: Atomically replaces the private run JSON record.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.read
outputs.description: Persisted run with abandoned running trials marked interrupted.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid run IDs or unavailable persisted records.
